sentences.text: A burning candle lit the table during our evening study session.
The boiling water spilled onto the kitchen floor this morning.
The broken cup lay on the kitchen floor beside the table.
The damaged road was repaired before the school term began after several weeks of heavy rain.
The students felt bored during the long lesson on local history.
The examination results have been surprising for many teachers and parents across the district this year.
I enjoy cooking simple meals with my family at weekends.
The students are interested in practising with the new software before their first group project begins.
I want to rest after a long day at school.
She needs a quiet place to stay during the university entrance exam.
They have a practical plan to reduce waste across the school campus.
He studies every evening to pass the important entrance test next month.
We left home early to avoid the heavy traffic on the main road.
They should wait near the school gate for their teacher.
Please let me help you with the difficult science project.
